reply.thought: The user has provided a batch of refunds applied by Alpha Co. My task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) using the `net_balance` tool and then record one payout per customer using `record_payout`. First, I need to list all orders to know which customers are involved and what their initial order amounts were. Since the refunds are tied to `order_id`s, I will assume the customers are associated with these order IDs for now, and listing orders is the first step to identify customers.

I have listed the orders. The customers involved are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. The task requires me to get the net balance for each customer using `net_balance(customer)` and then record a payout for that net balance. I will iterate through the unique customers and call `net_balance` for each one. I will start with 'acme'.
I have retrieved the net balance for 'acme' ($24701 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'acme'. Then I will proceed to the next customer, 'birch'.

I have retrieved the net balance for 'birch' ($61735 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'birch'. Then I will proceed to the last customer, 'cobalt'.
Payout recorded for 'birch'. Now I will get the net balance for the last customer, 'cobalt'.
I have retrieved the net balance for 'cobalt' ($16841 cents). Now I need to record the payout for 'cobalt'. After this, all customers will have been processed, and I can finish the task.
